title: Cokret Circle
description: Circle — intra-Realm scoped event/message boundary. Hosts its own membership (strict subset of parent Realm.members), history visibility, and delivery/query/projection boundary. It may be plaintext delivery-only or MLS-backed depending on encryption_profile and parent Realm policy floor. It does NOT carry federation identity, policy server, or capability registry — those remain on the parent Realm. Circle is NOT a principal Group; principal-set capability narrowing belongs on Group / capability constraint / resource selector. See spec/v1/zh/models/circle.md.

realm_id.description: Parent Realm. create-locked; Circle never re-binds to another Realm.

directory_visibility.description: Who may see this Circle exists as a directory entry. 'members' means only Circle members see its title/display/member_count. 'realm_members' exposes directory metadata only and does NOT grant event or history access.

join_rule.description: How an actor becomes a Circle member. 'open' lets any active Realm member self-join. 'request' requires profile-defined application/approval. 'invite' requires Circle admin add or invite.

history_visibility.description: Circle's own history visibility. Effective visibility MUST NOT be wider than the parent Realm's policy floor. See zh/authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md §6.

metadata_encryption_floor.description: Optional Circle-local metadata encryption floor. When omitted, the Circle inherits parent Realm's metadata_encryption_profile. May only tighten, never widen, parent Realm floor.

encryption_profile.description: Circle content encryption profile. create-locked. 'none' means plaintext delivery/query/projection isolation only and is allowed only when the parent Realm policy floor allows plaintext. 'mls_rfc9420' means the Circle owns an independent MLS group and MUST NOT derive its keys from the Realm-default MLS group.

mls_group_ref.description: Reducer-derived reference to the independent MLS group bound to (realm_id, circle_id). Present only when encryption_profile='mls_rfc9420'. Populated by ck.circle.create reducer; not actor-supplied on wire.

short_name.description: Human-facing short name. Unique per (realm_id, short_name) case-insensitive — reducer-enforced.

color_token.description: Color token from the spec-controlled palette. Clients MUST map token -> theme color (light/dark/high-contrast) consistently across devices; clients MUST NOT reassign tokens.
